title: Anterior Prolapse Repair With and Without Graft Augmentation
brief_summary: This is a randomized control trial comparing anterior colporrhaphy with augmentation with dermal allograft (ARCUS) to anterior colporrhaphy with a suture-based repair (native tissue). Patients were randomized to one treatment and then were followed post-operatively for 7-10 years. Prior to surgery patients had a POPQ vaginal prolapse exam and completed a quality of life questionaire (PFDI). They had a repeat POPQ exam and quality of life questionaires at their post-op operative visits. We compare recurrent prolapse rates between these 2 groups.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Any patient planning to undergo surgery for anterior compartment prolapse, English speaking.

\-

Exclusion Criteria: Any patient who does not speak English due to standardized English language based questionaires, and patients without anterior compartment prolapse.
